We have a partnership program for everyone — whether you’re expanding or just starting out. See how you can get started today.

# Become a service partner.

> Grow your customer base with Coda.

Market, sell, and deliver custom solutions to teams using Coda through the Coda partner directory, a marketplace for service partners.

We can help with:

Referring customers directly from Coda.

Training and best practices from Coda’s internal experts.

Awarding revenue when you refer new clients to Coda.

# Become a platform partner.

> Connect your business to Coda through Packs or marketplace apps.

Whether you’re extending the power of your solution with or developing a Coda integration for your marketplace, our resources for platform partners equip you with tools to attract new leads, increase app engagement, and empower makers.

We can help with:

Co-marketing planning and support.

Support for launching your Pack.

Listing your Pack in the Coda Gallery.

### Build a Pack.

Packs are extensions that customize how docs look, work, and integrate.

Building a Pack and publishing it to the Gallery enables makers to bring the power of your solution into their doc. Here are a few examples of Packs currently found in our Gallery:

![64.png](https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/VfvRWbcf62/blobs/bl-NpFx-YBibo/4dbd4a6ebdcd1afee354418cd7b4ca8e86f1726bc6febb877bf26ba51d84e2099110e0e68808620ab5725202e6d5b17f37e1f48675c74f0ae00d634f842f2a7b84e5dc5d894d208902ac73d31e6287d936fa7b020de6ce7d2bee42201a82d79262fcb7a2?fit=max&w=72&h=72&fm=webp&lossless=true)

### Blossom

Blossom leveraged Coda’s front-end to build and launch a user research application used by teams at Figma, Hootsuite, & more.

![image.png](https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/VfvRWbcf62/blobs/bl-EIKfSys9aT/9186e54f1221a373ab03804baccd9e0a54bb1417288bf3096f0fca0baafda6d212a38df1b6f5cb43ab900de1af477473eca73db09cf6fe5cbd96e292b0eeefc91d49cdebcf84cd40a6e117852598975b10196ab4ffd6f31a185b9562ac35a35b110e596a?fit=max&w=72&h=72&fm=webp&lossless=true)

### Tally

Tally unlocked highly requested features, like visualizing form results, through their Tally Pack.

![FintaBlackLogo.png](https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/VfvRWbcf62/blobs/bl-vycpQmeeMO/a59410c8a230ba50a01a5802f5d5d6f7a96669f42810fc93a8793154bbc9fa16d28facb066e53609f37e2106ab0ac3603f683a7a0317c3d8e2e43f2b40bb304ec34f0f42c90d4879fac385486782940266fd37b0ae500cd897c391c44d39764395252ff9?fit=max&w=210.88757396449705&h=210.88757396449705&fm=webp&lossless=true)

### Finta

Most budgeting apps are one-size-fits-all. The Finta Pack lets you customize your expense and investment tracking workflows through Coda.

### Create a Coda app for your business.

With our powerful API, you can create Coda apps or plug-ins for your marketplace.

By creating a Coda app, your users can seamlessly preview docs, pull in data from Coda tables, search your Coda docs through the URL bar, and more. Check out a few of our most popular plug-ins below:

![slack-new-logo-01.png](https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/VfvRWbcf62/blobs/bl-8u_q3KTo5c/b43bb9dff12f9b6455634fe4258c90a3f42dee990f08a9c07041c1a655d09278f800cf97c0fa4cb02dd18a48c568c5005ae7a1831346106e2e1c5cd39bcec11b9f57054ade2b69a627f21be762f32988b2f14a7dde46e3cafe0b082059fb1ea424f105ba?fit=max&w=72&h=72&fm=webp&lossless=true)

### Slack

Connect Slack to Coda and preview docs without clicking, forward Coda notifications to Slack, and more

![image.png](https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/VfvRWbcf62/blobs/bl-AuMLMUSmSI/12373c90f0b9d330fe6e02e608850e202780b380189c4958cf27ae3025058443201dc4eeb0d783d79e98bf9e85c024fa4d95271332d43fabb43e775e318c4d05b15b964e446ce0c19ea84a4205b86969844878301be36fbfce96acaf8c9b29e237afc4ea?fit=max&w=72&h=72&fm=webp&lossless=true)

### Figma

Design with real data. Bring data stored in Coda docs into your Figma designs, including Packs.

![Zoom - Camera.png](https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/VfvRWbcf62/blobs/bl--FNFGoKuGi/3316e3f6df6b5e4492dc2534178aae2f14d0235fb01461be1067aa9f33c819313a5dd82868fa4660814996f5537b7cc7f1eb4def13a71ee35fbd2bc98291b32b26ee07d0ba9ac3bb4d6a1494b7287607dc300639ef3ba524aaf42141bebab084c7a46dc6?fit=max&w=72&h=72&fm=webp&lossless=true)

### Zoom

Effortlessly manage your meetings, schedules, and recordings from a table in Coda.

# Become an affiliate partner.

> Earn funding and referral bonuses from Coda.

Our affiliate program is designed to help makers grow with Coda. As an affiliate partner, you’ll receive a portion of the revenue collected in the first year of each new maker you refer.

We can help with:

Awarding Coda credit each time your doc is copied by a new maker.

Awarding cash when a referred maker upgrades to a paid plan.

Marketing guides and best practices.

# Additional partner opportunities.

Looking for something else? We got you covered. In addition to the above program, you can also apply to join one of our partnership programs.
